authority: Existing project, repository, identity and publication authority; this procedure grants none.

policy.managed_text: LF in canonical storage and materialization
policy.scope: identified managed text and explicit byte-preserving exclusions
policy.identities: Preserve each existing identity basis; do not remove BOMs, change encodings or recompute all identities.

bootstrap.basis: Actual policy/configuration reads and authorized administrative preparation; no artificial writes, checkout trials or functional certification.
bootstrap.publication: Combine eligible policy publication with an already-required authorized canonical change when safe; policy preparation alone does not prove publication.

reconciliation.trigger: existing operations missing or conflicting policy or materially affected content
reconciliation.idempotence: Read actual state and retained evidence first; never replay an already satisfied transformation.
reconciliation.failure: Retain completed and remaining work; block affected publication or unsupported portability claims, continue independent safe work.

backend_profiles.when: Only when this is the selected repository backend; other backends must supply equivalent scoped behavior.
backend_profiles.preparation: Preserve existing rules; place the required default before explicit protected-content exceptions. Do not append it over unrelated rules blindly.
backend_profiles.exclusions: Use explicit -text rules for identified byte-sensitive content; automatic text detection alone is not an exclusion policy.
backend_profiles.effective_readback: Inspect relevant text/eol attributes and their scoped origins, including nested and local overrides, through the controlled invocation. File presence is insufficient.
backend_profiles.existing_content: Inspect stored and working content. If needed, renormalize only reviewed eligible paths under a conditional authorized canonical change; verify the diff and preserve excluded bytes.
backend_profiles.inherited_settings: Do not change personal/global settings. Reconcile authorized local conflicts or report the precise affected dependency.

limits: LF evidence covers its declared content scope, not total portability. Assess materially relevant names, case collisions, references and formats separately. Producer regressions are not installed consumer evidence.
